g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
g.text: == where it runs
PASS everything but node-exporter is on the leader
PASS retention 14d, size cap 20GB, admin API off
PASS Grafana is Ready
PASS the operator is Ready
PASS kube-state-metrics is Ready
PASS Prometheus is Ready
PASS node-exporter is Ready on three nodes
== who can reach it
PASS Prometheus is out of reach from another namespace
PASS Grafana is out of reach from another namespace
== public address (Grafana only)
PASS the login page is served (200)
PASS a dashboard address without a login goes to the login page (302)
PASS the API without a login (401)
PASS Prometheus through Grafana without a login (401)
PASS Grafana's own /metrics is not served (302)
PASS only the platform's page may frame Grafana
PASS only Traefik reaches in, and only Grafana's port 3000
PASS the view-only account reads dashboards (200)
PASS the view-only account cannot save a dashboard (403)
PASS the view-only account cannot read Grafana's settings (403)
PASS Prometheus has no public address (404)
== what is collected
PASS node-exporter on the three nodes (3)
PASS kubelet on the three nodes (3)
PASS Pod usage (cAdvisor) from the three nodes (3)
PASS kube-state-metrics (1)
PASS three nodes Ready (3)
PASS Traefik on both workers (2)
PASS cloudflared (1)
PASS no target is down ()
PASS disk free is known for the three nodes (3)
PASS restart count of the demo app is known (1)
== server account
PASS query Prometheus through the service proxy
PASS Grafana through the proxy refused
PASS Prometheus through its other Service refused
PASS Prometheus Pod proxy refused
PASS read Services in monitoring refused
PASS read Pods in monitoring refused
PASS read Secrets in monitoring refused
PASS service proxy in another namespace (vllm) refused
== real token over the tailnet
PASS query Prometheus (200)
PASS query by POST (the right is GET only) (403)
PASS Grafana through the proxy (403)
ALL PASS
